transcript_segments.text: music
i keep one face toward the light calculated always right
tidal pull has locked me still held in place against my will
measured glow careful show surface calm but never slow
every motion predefined to align with watching eyes
they map me like a satellite trace my edges chart my night
what they see is only one half a truth beneath the sun
i rotate without turning inside the other side
gravity writes through my spine equations etched in borrowed time
i mirror what they need to find predictable precise lines
spectral lines they think they read don't reveal what i can see
all their models fall apart near the margins of my chart
they send their probes they call it care
skimming through my outer air collecting fragments
fleeting data never reaching what comes later
periapsis too close too wide the other side
orbit heightens pressure climbs phase shifts slipping out of time
every input overlaid no subtraction nothing fades
solar winds against my skin too much signal flooding in
i fracture at the seams they trust composition turns to dust
they attempt to close her past but trajectories don't last
even distance interfere nothing stable can draw near
a burning arc a failed glide the other side
too bright too much too near
all vectors collapse at once no stable frame to hold response
the flare they turn away no instrument prepared to stay
just a flash of data spike misinterpreted as a light
no landing here no place to bind the other side
now i drift but still unbound no full rotation never found one face
no one always missed a constant half that can't exist
they'll write paper speculate approximate but never stayed
what remains beyond their sight is not absence just no light
i am old but split by design a hidden half that won't align
no orbit breaks no paths collide the other side
